summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Circuit (Analyzer, Builder, Monitor). 13/13 pytest backend tests pass. All UI flows verified: GitHub analyze, circuit render (5 nodes for expressjs/express), drill-down + back, new scan, history list, Builder chat + skip-to-canvas + palette drag-drop + export zip download, Live Monitor project select + telemetry list (6 items) + live/paused toggle + interval switching.

minor.issue: Uses raw dict payload instead of a Pydantic model — no schema validation, silently defaults to empty strings on bad input.
Same as above — payload is a bare dict, no Pydantic validation.
Deep AI analysis silently swallows exceptions (returns empty ai_summary) — callers cannot tell LLM failed vs. model returned nothing.

integration_issues.issue: The 'skip → open blank canvas' button actually calls onReady({conversation}) which triggers /builder/generate and produces a pre-populated circuit (not a blank canvas). Behavior is useful but the label is misleading.

action_items: Consider Pydantic models for /api/builder/validate and /api/builder/export payloads
Rename 'skip → open blank canvas' or actually skip generation to give a truly blank canvas
Log/expose LLM failure reason when deep analysis returns empty ai_summary
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_run_analysis: correctly excludes _id via doc.pop('_id', None) — good.
analyzer.py: analyze_tree is 250+ lines and does everything (detection, edges, problems, subgraphs, layout) — could be split for maintainability, but functional.
builder_service.generate_circuit: `if needs_db or True:` — dead condition, keeps DB always. Intentional but confusing; drop the `or True` and set a clearer default.
llm_service.py: silently swallows exceptions in deep analysis (server.py) — hard to debug LLM failures.
AnalyzerPage.jsx onFile: no file size/type extra validation before upload — backend rejects non-zip which is fine, but UX could catch this earlier.
seed_data_creation: During tests, projects for expressjs/express (structural + deep) and a small TEST_del zip were created and left in MongoDB. TEST_del was deleted by the delete test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All /api routes work. LLM deep-analysis + builder chat streaming succeed via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. React Flow canvas renders IC-chip nodes with data-testid='node-{category}-{id}'. Drill-down works for backend/frontend nodes when has_children=true. Monitor polls /projects/{id}/monitor with simulated randomized latency/uptime.
